name: grok-openrouter-kimi
summary: Replaced stub implementations with full Grok (xAI Responses API), OpenRouter (Chat Completions), and Kimi (Chat Completions) providers.
completed_work: Grok provider: Implemented full review() using xAI Responses API (https://api.x.ai/v1/responses). Model: grok-3. Response format matches OpenAI Responses structure.
OpenRouter provider: Implemented full review() using Chat Completions API with messages array. Model: openai/gpt-5 default. Uses bearer token auth.
Kimi provider: Implemented full review() using Chat Completions API (https://api.moonshot.cn/v1/chat/completions). Model: moonshot-v1-auto default.
All three providers implement LLMProvider interface with review(), reviewStream() stub, and validateApiKey().
Response parsing logic is consistent across all providers (### section splitting, fallback strategies).
decisions: Grok uses Responses API (not Chat Completions) as specified by the user requirement. The response format mirrors OpenAI Responses.
OpenRouter and Kimi use Chat Completions API with system/user message format — OpenAI-compatible.
All providers share the same section-parsing logic for consistency. If a provider returns a different format, it will gracefully degrade with per-item fallback messages.

contract_surface_for_step4.All 4 providers: reviewStream() stubs ready for SSE streaming implementation in Step 4
